notes: A backrooms game with entities is Survival's Liminal Horror preset almost by definition — a pursuing threat in repeating liminal architecture — so shape and options come straight from it. interior-endless is right even though the scale answer asks for one large fixed floor, because the answers also confirm there is no exit to reach; the floor is built to read as unbounded, and its P6 stays since corridor connectivity has to be valid by construction rather than left to an image. Entities become spawner-npc as hostile AI with an origin and patrol ground, and cover-los supplies the closets and wall cutouts that make hiding possible. Kept the preset's collectible-nodes for scattered supplies since nothing in the prompt contradicts it, and added no escape gate because surviving as long as possible is the stated goal.
